children: Cathay General Bancorp received regulatory approval to increase its share repurchase program by $50 million, bringing the total authorization to $200 million.
The increased authorization follows prior board approval and allows repurchases of up to $200 million of common stock.
Approximately $113 million remained available under the program as of November 25, 2026, after giving effect to the increase.
The company had repurchased 1,407,189 shares at an average cost of $61.86 per share.
The program expires April 23, 2027; repurchases may occur on the open market or in privately negotiated transactions.
Management will determine repurchase timing, price and volume based on market conditions, securities laws and other factors; the program may be modified or suspended.
